text:
Maria: Quick sync — Sundial Models sent a term sheet for their 13B and 70B open weights. They want the models listed on our marketplace and a co-marketing blurb. Who needs to weigh in?
Alec: Legal and export for sure. Also eng for quantization/packaging constraints.
Jordan: From eng side: we need clarity on allowed redistributions (do they permit patched/quantized artifacts?). If not, we can't ship our optimized bundles.
Li: @Maria can you paste the exact clause? I skimmed their email but it was vague about rehosting/derivative works.
Maria: Copied the relevant snippet below.

"""
Section 4.b: "Partner grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to redistribute model weights (including quantized and otherwise optimized variants) solely for the purpose of marketplace distribution and inference-as-a-service. Partner retains ownership of underlying model weights. Redistribution to third-party resellers requires separate consent."
"""

Priya: Marketing: we can do a joint announcement, but need a comms window and logos cleared. Legal signoff on language first.
Ben: Partnerships: also flag hardware bundling. Sundial asked whether we can list an "optimized on HWCo A100X" SKU. HWCo requires a separate approval from their bizdev.
Jordan: Technical follow-ups: we need the original model config + sample outputs and a permissive license file. Also ask for a reproducible seed/checksum. For packaging, our runtime expects a traced config: 
```
model-card.json
vocab.txt
pytorch_model.bin
quantization-manifest.json
```
Alec: Legal asks to confirm three items before OK: explicit permission to ship quantized variants, clarity on redistribution to customers (SaaS inference vs. downloads), and export control self-attestation (ECCN).
Maria: I'll get Sundial to confirm those three. Timeline: they want marketplace listing before their Feb event — that's tight.
Priya: If we want co-marketing at their event, we'll need final logo + 1-line partner quote by T-10 business days.
Li: Devex/eng ops: if they allow quantized derivatives, we can produce a 4-variant SKU mapping: fp16, int8, int4, and an on-prem encrypted bundle. Need to know if encrypted on-prem distribution is allowed.
Ben: Also renegotiate the "no-resale" clause. They forbid third-party resellers; that blocks some of our channel partners. Can we propose a limited reseller carveout tied to compliance checks?
Alec: Fine with proposing carveout, but legal needs indemnity language and audit rights. I'll draft counter language.
Maria: Partners-bot: added task cards.
partners-bot: Task created — "Sundial terms: confirm quantization + redistribution + export attestation" assigned to Maria, due 2026-02-06. :robot_face:
Jordan: One more technical ask — provide benchmark traces for standard prompts and long-context tests. We need them to validate latency & memory for routing policies.
Priya: Marketing note: suggest joint launch blog + a short demo notebook. If they allow embedding of model samples we can pre-produce an interactive notebook for their event.
Alec: I'll circulate a 1-page redline for the term sheet by EOD tomorrow. If Sundial agrees to quantization + restricted reseller carveout + ECCN attestation, legal is OK.
Maria: Great. Action items: 1) Maria ping Sundial for explicit clauses (Alec helped list), 2) Jordan lists packaging/benchmark checklist, 3) Priya drafts comms timeline, 4) Ben starts reseller carveout proposal. We'll regroup Friday 11am.
Ben: noted.
Jordan: sending packaging checklist now — uploading to shared drive. link: https://redwood.co/sundial-packaging
Maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
